spec_version: SPEC.md sections 8.1-8.3; round-2 implementation corrects round-1 analysis defects: operational/structural hard kills require the spec's high-success thresholds, and proceed rule 1 uses 5 percentage points rather than 20
hard_kill_adaptation_note: the spec's 'every one of four models' language is applied to every gate-valid round-2 model and requires at least two gate-valid models; models failing validity gates are not allowed to establish either a hard kill or a proceed signal

extractor_mutation_detail.strict_extraction_rule: exactly one <OUT> and one </OUT>; no non-whitespace outside wrappers; extracted bytes are compared without stripping, normalization, or repair

vintage_contrast.interpretation_note: Positive difference means newer tokenizers have a larger newest-minus-old failure gap than the Llama-2-vintage carrier. Validity-gate failures make this descriptive rather than interpretable.

regression_stop_rule: not needed for round-2 decision because tokenizer-scan rule 4 already fires
